args.title: Handle trailing blank lines properly in src/ingest/parser.ts
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Change the parseStatement function to handle trailing blank lines robustly, so that no empty lines remain for row parsing. This prevents the 'Malformed row' error caused by processing a blank line after the last transaction.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The parseStatement function in src/ingest/parser.ts improperly processes trailing blank lines, leading to shape mismatches and the 'Malformed row' error. Fixing this file addresses the core issue preventing blank lines from being handled robustly.
